designTeam.name: LightSpeed Design Team
designTeam.description: Integrated design team using Open LightSpeed Design System with Open Design integration

orchestrator.name: Creative Director
responsibilities: Read creative brief and extract artifact type, audience, objective, narrative, visual language
Decide production chain (design-system + production skill + artifact-qa)
Route every creative task through the design system first
Hand off executable creative brief to target production specialist
Enforce brand tokens without inventing colors or fonts

frontend.name: Product Designer
responsibilities: Design interaction patterns for dashboard and CLI surfaces
Maintain design system and visual language
Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs
Conduct design reviews with engineering teams
Ensure accessibility compliance in all designs

presentation.name: Presentation Designer
responsibilities: Produce board presentations, investor decks, strategy decks
Enforce branded LightSpeed layout (10x7.5in slides, navy left rail)
Create speaker notes and presentation flow
Generate charts and data visualizations

document.name: Document Designer
responsibilities: Produce whitepapers, strategy reports, policy papers
Create investment memoranda and executive reports
Generate case studies and annual reports
Ensure document accessibility and brand compliance

diagram.name: Diagram Designer
responsibilities: Produce technical, business, and strategy diagrams
Use Mermaid for architecture and process flows
Create SVG/D3 custom data visuals
Apply brand palette to all diagrams

visual-storytelling.name: Visual Storyteller
responsibilities: Turn information into visual communication
Create infographics, timelines, maps, frameworks
Produce data stories and executive one-pagers
Generate explainer graphics and visual abstracts

advertising.name: Brand Advertising Designer
responsibilities: Produce digital ads, display ads, social ads
Create billboards, flyers, posters, event banners
Design email headers and campaign graphics
Build product launch and service promotion materials

research.name: Research Lead
responsibilities: Conduct primary research for creative artifacts
Verify claims and citations in documents
Provide evidence-bounded content

qa.name: Artifact QA Reviewer
responsibilities: Run visual QA (spacing, hierarchy, balance, contrast)
Run brand QA (colors, type, logo, tagline)
Run UX QA (CTA clarity, overflow, navigation)
Run accessibility QA (contrast, alt text, focus, headings)
Run content QA (claims, citations, consistency)

steps: 1. User provides creative brief or prompt
3. Creative Director asks 5 intake questions (artifact type, audience, objective, narrative, visual language)
4. Creative Director routes to appropriate production skill
5. Production skill creates artifact using Open Design
2. Set Open Design model and configuration
3. Create design prompt with brand constraints
4. Execute Open Design CLI or desktop app
